scope: Internal five-seat AgentOps topology, interruption recovery, functional scale, and cleanup retry on Arena
release_boundary: This evidence does not certify 25 AgentOps seats, public-code access, trusted public TLS, a 60-minute soak, or the exact September three-workshop fleet rehearsal.

fault_injection_and_recovery.trigger: Arena worker rhgnr1 temporarily reported NotReady while the single Launchpad backend was provisioning the second seat wave
fault_injection_and_recovery.initial_recovery_result: four ready seats and one failed seat
fault_injection_and_recovery.initial_failure: a deterministic seat namespace was reused while its prior incarnation was still Terminating
fault_injection_and_recovery.recovery_after_fix: only the failed seat was requeued; the four ready seats were retained; five of five became ready
fault_injection_and_recovery.cleanup_defect: a stale interrupted session could replace the current seat link and cause duplicate Argo cleanup
fault_injection_and_recovery.cleanup_recovery: current seat links are now authoritative and completed_with_errors cleanup can be retried idempotently

cleanup.initial_record_error: duplicate cleanup of a stale relinked session observed an already deleted Argo application

red_green_matrix.requirement: bounded steady and transient capacity accounting
red_green_matrix.red: legacy multiplication counted rollout pods as steady per-seat demand
red_green_matrix.green_local: capacity and catalog contract tests pass
red_green_matrix.green_live: five-seat preview reports 60 steady plus eight bounded transient pods; 25 reports 308 and rejects admission

red_green_matrix.requirement: validation follows the active rollout generation
red_green_matrix.red: a terminating old DSPA pod caused a false validation failure
red_green_matrix.green_live: all five sessions reached ready with zero failed validation checks

red_green_matrix.red: an existing validation_failed session could be promoted to a ready seat without another validation
red_green_matrix.green_live: the one-seat session was revalidated to ready before workshop completion

red_green_matrix.requirement: interrupted deterministic namespaces are not reused while terminating
red_green_matrix.red: live recovery received NamespaceTerminating while creating the participant RoleBinding
red_green_matrix.green_local: recovery waits for confirmed namespace absence
red_green_matrix.green_live: the failed fourth seat reprovisioned into the same deterministic namespace only after deletion and reached ready

red_green_matrix.requirement: reclaim preserves the current session for each seat
red_green_matrix.red: a stale retry session overwrote a ready seat and generated duplicate cleanup
red_green_matrix.green_local: stale-session relink regression and cleanup suites pass
red_green_matrix.green_live: build-92 retry retained five current seat links and completed with zero failed reclaims

red_green_matrix.red: completed_with_errors was terminal and DELETE could not retry it
red_green_matrix.green_live: the same order moved completed_with_errors to reclaiming to completed without recreating resources

test_strategy.TDD: Every live defect was reproduced by a failing regression before implementation.
test_strategy.EDD: This manifest records source revisions, immutable image digest, order and session identifiers, capacity, participant functionality, interruption behavior, and zero-residue cleanup.
test_strategy.CDD: Capacity resource_breakdown, immutable workload revision, workshop retry, session validation, and cleanup-retry contracts remain backward compatible for internal orders.
test_strategy.BDD: Given a five-seat internal AgentOps order, when Arena interrupts the control-plane worker, completed seats remain assigned, incomplete work is reconciled and retried, every participant journey succeeds, and reclaim leaves no resources.
test_strategy.CBT: Catalog, Helm topology, capacity, Argo, DSPA, routes, Antora, terminal RBAC, AI WebSockets, retry, credential scrubbing, and cleanup were independently checked before the integrated journey.

release_decision.next_gate: add and qualify at least one additional 250-pod AgentOps worker, then run 25-seat internal certification
